veritas-bible-church-federal-way.assessment: Veritas Bible Church in Federal Way, WA is one of the strongest finds in the Pacific Northwest. Member Vlad Yakubets confirms the church holds a PATRIARCHAL (not merely complementarian) view — "men are the rulers of God's world in every sphere of life." This is the full biblical manhood vision. Annual men's retreat and men's small groups provide masculine discipleship without bureaucratic programming. Expository preaching, Scripture-centered identity ("Veritas" = truth), Reformed/evangelical theology. The only yellow is independence (no denominational accountability) — but when the culture is this sound, that's a minor concern. Personally recommended by Vlad Yakubets. One of the few GREEN churches in the entire Pacific Northwest.

score_notes.christology: Scripture-centered; affirms Jesus as the Word of eternal life (John 6:68-69).
